title: button widget
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkButtonWidget with textured 3D, 2D, and Prop3D button representations.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkAppendPolyData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkAppendPolyData.html) — append poly data.
- [vtkButtonWidget](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkButtonWidget.html) — button widget.
- [vtkConeSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkConeSource.html) — generates a polygonal cone.
- [vtkEllipticalButtonSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkEllipticalButtonSource.html) — elliptical button source.
- [vtkGlyph3D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGlyph3D.html) — places oriented, scaled glyphs at each point.
- [vtkLookupTable](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLookupTable.html) — maps scalar values to colors.
- [vtkPNGReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPNGReader.html) — png reader.
- [vtkPlatonicSolidSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPlatonicSolidSource.html) — platonic solid source.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkProp3DButtonRepresentation](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkProp3DButtonRepresentation.html) — prop3d button representation.
- [vtkSphereSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSphereSource.html) — generates a tessellated sphere.
- [vtkTIFFReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTIFFReader.html) — reads TIFF image files.
- [vtkTexturedButtonRepresentation](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTexturedButtonRepresentation.html) — textured button representation.
- [vtkTexturedButtonRepresentation2D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTexturedButtonRepresentation2D.html) — textured button representation2d.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
